column3: Kuroneko Route · Decisive Sentence
At any rate...
Even though we've come this far, you haven't said the decisive sentence.
I see that you're really incompetent... but it's really pitiable to be looking down on you, right? Because there's still a curse on you.
A curse...? What's that? I don't remember anything like that.
Of course there is. From your way of thinking, and your lips, carries the curse of 'true incompetence'.
You just can't notice 'that'... and also, you won't say it even if it's wrong.
Good grief, it's really a nuisance. If it wasn't there, I'm sure the conversation will end at this instant.
No... It's because of that curse, that I'm able to be here.
Kuroneko? What are you saying?
Hehe... I'm saying, allow me to release you from that curse.
Like I was saying, what curse...
Hmm...!
This is a ritual to break the curse. And now I'll make a new one.
My curse has been sent to overwrite your current curse.
And now, the curse of incompetence that was on you will slowly disappear.
And my curse will be, the ceremonial curse. I'll officially make you as my companion.
It's different from before, not simply a companion contract... it's stronger and deeper in meaning, a contract that binds the souls of two people.
How about it? I'm about to set in place this very contract onto you now.
What's your... response?
Ahh... I'm awakened. Even if it's me, I understand it now.
As I was saying, I'm asking you, what's your response?
Your eyes are telling me to quickly answer you... however.
Can't you use simpler terms to put it across clearly?
I feel that if that's the case, I would have noticed it earlier...
...Didn't I tell you before?
My character is twisted. Besides that, how about hurrying up and answering my question?
Who was it that said it before, that both of our characters are twisted?
Like I was saying, how much longer are you planning to tease me?
Haha... Besides, I'm sure you know what I'm going to say in response, don't you?
...It's a necessary fact that both sides must agree to the contract, even when you make a deal with the devil, it's not unilateral...
Just say that you want me to say it directly, though she's definitely cuter that way.
Maybe I shouldn't push that shy girl too much or she'll get angry.
...I get it. I'll answer you.
My response is...
I certainly don't have to say it directly, do I?
